entities.name: TB window prophylaxis <5
observations: CDC-style contact management: in an asymptomatic child younger than 5 years with active TB excluded by evaluation and a negative initial TST, begin window preventive therapy and repeat testing 8–10 weeks after last exposure; a negative initial test does not justify observation alone.

entities.name: Tuberculosis
observations: Active TB disease must be excluded before preventive treatment is given to an exposed child.

entities.name: Isoniazid
observations: Isoniazid is a commonly used option for window prophylaxis in young child TB contacts; regimen and duration should be confirmed with the TB program and source-case susceptibility.

entities.name: ZIM schistosomiasis Ghana
observations: A 2024 schoolchildren study in southern Ghana explicitly used zero-inflated and hurdle regression models to analyze schistosomiasis data (DOI:10.1371/journal.pone.0304681).

entities.name: ZIR helminths Ethiopia
observations: A 2020 study of helminth infections among rural schoolchildren in southern Ethiopia used a zero-inflated regression model (DOI:10.1371/journal.pntd.0008002).

entities.name: ZINB fecal egg counts
observations: A 2023 conference abstract titled Fit of the Zero-Inflated Negative Binomial Model to Analyze Fecal Egg Counts indicates application to helminth egg-count data (DOI not returned in search record).
